title: Cottages by River Tolka, Dublin, Ireland

events.n: photographed on a visit for a British Vogue feature
events.q: In November 1946 Lee Miller visited Dublin for a British Vogue feature about the Irish capital and the writing of James Joyce.

events.n: where it was taken, in Miller's words
events.q: Taken from the road bridge over the Tolka on Drumcondra Road.

events.t: People and Ideas: When James Joyce lived in Dublin
events.q: US Vogue,  'People and Ideas: When James Joyce lived in Dublin' article by Constantine P. Curran, images by Lee Miller. May 1st 1947 p 147
